name: Longwei Automobiles
description: Experience the pinnacle of Chinese luxury automobiles.
story: Longwei Automobiles, a symbol of modern Chinese innovation and craftsmanship, seeks to expand its global brand recognition through motorsport. Founded on the principles of performance and prestige, Longwei sees a partnership in racing as a perfect alignment with their brand values. They are looking for a team that embodies excellence and can deliver consistent results on the track.
